description:
【7000W Peak Powerful Electric Bike】Top-tier configuration, the GT500 electric bike will take you to explore the unknown and enjoy the passion and thrill of riding. Equipped with a powerful 60V 3000W motor (peak 7000W), it delivers strong power. Top speed up to 55 mph (after removing the speed limit), letting you feel the thrill of strong wind against your face and making every ride a free and exciting adventure.

【Front & Rear Suspension System】The GT500 electric dirt bike is equipped with an inverted front fork suspension and rear air suspension system, greatly reducing bumps during riding and improving riding stability and comfort. You won't feel tired even on long rides. The professional 7-speed transmission system allows you to easily handle rugged terrains such as mountains, rocks, rivers, and deserts.

【60V 30Ah Battery, Explore Without Limits】Equipped with an upgraded 60V 30Ah large-capacity removable battery, the GT500 fat tire electric bike can travel up to 80-90 km on electric power alone. No more worries about running out of battery mid-ride. With the 67.2V 3A fast charger, it can be fully charged in 8-10 hours. After a good night's sleep, you'll be ready to set off again and explore the unknown and the infinite.

【19-Inch All-Terrain Tires】The GT500 adult electric bike uses 19-inch off-road motorcycle tires, ensuring excellent stability and comfort across all terrains such as snow, sand, and gravel roads. The 19-inch tire height is suitable for most adult men and women. Combined with front and rear hydraulic disc brakes, you can enjoy responsive and powerful braking even on steep slopes, rugged terrain, or other extreme terrains. Make your adventurous exploration a free and worry-free experience.
